hero.bannerLine1: WE CREATE SHOES AND ACCESSORIES FOR THE CONSUMERS

about.heading: ABOUT US
about.body1_html: UnfoldCreative is a hub where imagination breathes life into footwear, where ideas unfold gently and tomorrow's trends take root.
about.body2_html: Within these walls, the spirit of made in Europe meets a global eye, creating pieces that feel refined, modern, and effortlessly authentic.

mission.heading: MISSION
mission.body1_html: We create shoes that balances culture, commerce, and design. From commercial to premium brands, we develop collections with a strong point of view and clear market relevance.
mission.body2_html: Rooted in craftsmanship, our work helps brands build stronger products and more meaningful consumer connections.

departments.heading: DEPARTMENTS
departments.intro: We guide products from first idea to final prototype — combining concept design, material sourcing, product development, and prototyping into one seamless process.
departments.intro_html: We guide products from first idea to final prototype — combining concept design, material sourcing, product development, and prototyping into one seamless process.

trend.heading: TRENDRESEARCH
trend.body: Our Trend & Strategy division tracks shifts in culture, consumer behaviour, and the market to help shape products with lasting value.
trend.body_html: Our Trend & Strategy division tracks shifts in culture, consumer behaviour, and the market to help shape products with lasting value.
trend.body2_html: Through forecasting, competitor analysis, and strategic positioning, we turn insight into clear direction and stronger product decisions.

design.heading: DESIGN / STYLE
design.body: Our designers turn ideas into shapes with attitude.
design.body_html: Our designers turn ideas into shapes with attitude.
design.body2_html: From early concepts and seasonal direction to sketching, rendering, and collection building, they create products that balance culture, function, with a strong point of view.

sourcing.heading: SOURCING
sourcing.body: Our material archive is in constant motion — updated seasonally with new leathers, textiles, colours, and components sourced from across the industry.
sourcing.body_html: Our material archive is in constant motion — updated seasonally with new leathers, textiles, colours, and components sourced from across the industry.

laboratory.heading: LABORATORY
laboratory.body: Behind every product is a development process shaped by precision, technical thinking, and attention to detail —
laboratory.body_html: Behind every product is a development process shaped by precision, technical thinking, and attention to detail —
laboratory.body2_html: combining last and mold development, prototype building, technical specifications, and digital tools to turn ideas into functional products ready for production.

graphics.heading: GRAPHICS
graphics.body: Our Graphic Design division shapes the details that give a brand its identity — creating logos, packaging, outsole graphics, apparel prints, and presentations that feel consistent, considered, and connected to the product.
graphics.body_html: Our Graphic Design division shapes the details that give a brand its identity — creating logos, packaging, outsole graphics, apparel prints, and presentations that feel consistent, considered, and connected to the product.

innovation.heading: INNOVATION / TECH HUB
innovation.intro1_html: Our Innovation and Technical Development division turns concepts into production-ready products through a combination of digital design and technical expertise.
innovation.intro2_html: From 3D modeling, prototyping, and rendering to tech packs, construction specs, fit testing, and factory coordination, we support the full development process from concept to production.

contact.teaser_body2: We're always looking for ambitious brands, fresh perspectives, and projects.
